lines.en: I hang under a leaf, swaying gently.
A gust comes and I swing once.

lines.zh: 我从这根枝挪到那根枝。
lines.en: I shift from this twig to that one.

lines.zh: 我的壳带着淡淡的笑纹。
lines.en: My shell bears a faint smiling pattern.
I crawl slowly along the branch tip.

lines.zh: 叶子被我压得微微下垂。
lines.en: The leaf dips a little under my weight.
I am looking for a steadier spot.
My casing is hard and very light.
I sway along with the branch.
Patches of light shift through the wood.
I pause against the leaf vein.
I move myself into the shade.
I turn slowly along the leaf's edge.

lines.zh: 一滴雨打在壳上，我晃了晃。
lines.en: A raindrop strikes my casing and I rock.

lines.zh: 我把自己转到背光的一面。
lines.en: I shift around to the shaded side.

lines.zh: 枝条下沉了一点，又弹回。
lines.en: The twig dips a little, then springs back.

lines.zh: 我数着叶子投下的光斑。
lines.en: I count the spots of light the leaves cast.

lines.zh: 里面有什么在慢慢改变。
lines.en: Something inside is slowly changing.

lines.zh: 我数着太阳走过的角度。
lines.en: I count the sun's angle as it moves.
Dew drips from the leaf tip.

lines.zh: 壳里透出一点翅的颜色。
lines.en: A little of my wing color shows through the shell.
The wind stopped, and so did I.
A bird calls nearby.

lines.zh: 我在等一个合适的早上。
lines.en: I wait for the right morning.
The wood is damp. I am comfortable.
My shape grows clearer within.

lines.zh: 我听见远处溪水的声音。
lines.en: I hear a stream somewhere off.

lines.zh: 我在这片叶子上待了很久。
lines.en: I have been on this leaf a long while.
Do not shake this branch.

lines.zh: 我看得见你，只是动不了。
lines.en: I can see you; I simply cannot move.
I am not a butterfly yet.
Are you thinking of picking me off?
Wait a little. I am coming out soon.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把蛹吹得发凉。
lines.en: Your breath chills the chrysalis.

lines.zh: 我猜你也看见那个笑纹了。
lines.en: I suppose you see the smile too.
The sun comes through from behind you.
I know that net in your hand.
I am quite safe here.
A crack runs through my casing.
I swing hard on the branch.
Something inside shifted.
I cannot cry out; I can only shrink.

lines.zh: 叶子被我扯歪，蛹也斜了。
lines.en: I pulled the leaf crooked and the cocoon tilted.

lines.zh: 我的蛹壳上，有一道笑纹。
lines.en: A smiling seam runs along my chrysalis.
My casing has gone a little soft.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶柄上，勉强稳住。
lines.en: I cling to the stalk and barely hold.
Time seems to have sped up.
The smile line on my shell has gone crooked.

lines.zh: 我封在壳里，吃不到你的叶。
lines.en: I am sealed in my shell and cannot reach your leaf.
Those leaves are not for me.
You hold something under the branch.
My casing is sealed; I cannot smell it.
Bring it closer so I can look.
I am changing inside; I have no time for that.
Do not put your hand on the leaf.
That smell is unfamiliar.
Set it down and take two steps back.
Not yet emerged. Still in the woods.
You touched the branch and I swung.
My casing is hard; do not worry about me.
You knocked the leaf askew.
I pull in a little.
That had little effect.
I grip the leaf stalk tightly.
Do not touch my casing.
We are crowded on the same twig.
I sway twice before settling.
Step back and the wind will right it.
Keep watch over this leaf.
When I emerge, I will fly for you.
There is no other chrysalis sound in this wood.
Neither of us needs to make a sound.
Just come and look at me each day.
There are three great trees in this wood.
Do not let anyone pick me off.

lines.zh: 我的壳上带着淡淡的笑纹。
lines.en: A faint smile line runs across my shell.
Wait until the wind is warmer.
You need not be in a hurry either.

lines.zh: 我动不了，只能看着你靠近。
lines.en: I cannot move; I can only watch you near.
Is that something you dropped?
It is right under the leaf.
I nudged it with my casing.
My feet are too soft to grip it.
It rolled off the branch.
Do not stoop; you will snap the branch.
This thing shines in the sun.
I push it against the leaf stalk.
Leave it here; someone will come for it.
The only thing I fix on is that patch of light.

lines.zh: 光从你的肩边斜过去了。
lines.en: The light slants past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 林间的蛹，只等自己裂开。
lines.en: A forest chrysalis only waits to split.
My legs are still curled.
Wait until my wings unfold, then we settle it.
Just step aside a little.

lines.zh: 这张叶我占了，别往上放东西。
lines.en: This leaf is taken; put nothing on it.
I am not afraid of you, and I cannot move.
I am waiting for the moment of emergence.
Come near; I will not dodge.

lines.zh: 我盯着你要碰哪片叶子。
lines.en: I watch which leaf you mean to touch.

lines.zh: 你的手停在那儿很久了。
lines.en: Your hand has hovered there a long while.
When the light changes, I know.
I can see even from inside my casing.
Do not touch that slender twig.
My casing is growing thinner.
A little more and the time will come.
Inside my shell I count your breaths.
The wind comes from your direction.
Your shadow has not moved away.
I cannot reach you.
My casing is hard; your hand will hurt.
I swung once on the branch.
If you mean to squeeze me, I tighten first.
I fell and landed in the grass.

lines.zh: 我什么也没做，只是挂着。
lines.en: I did nothing; I merely hung there.
You touched me. Very lightly.
I hid under the leaf a moment.
There is a fingerprint on my casing.
Let go and I will be safe.
The caterpillar spun its last loop of silk.
The caterpillar left me here.

lines.zh: 森林里多了一个小小的茧。
lines.en: There is one small chrysalis more in the forest.
I hang beneath a slender twig.
Leaf veins print their pattern on my casing.
I hang quietly.

lines.zh: 有人走过，叶子动了一下。
lines.en: Someone passed, and the leaf moved.
I have changed from the caterpillar's shape.

lines.zh: 这是我一生中最静的时节。
lines.en: This is the stillest season of my life.
The sun falls just right on me.

lines.zh: 热气把我的壳烤得发脆。
lines.en: The heat has made my casing brittle.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下来，壳磕了一下。
lines.en: I fell from the branch and my casing struck.

lines.zh: 水渗进壳里，里面的东西慌了。
lines.en: Water seeps in, and what is inside stirs in alarm.

lines.zh: 气浪把整根枝都掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast flips the whole twig over.

lines.zh: 箭羽扫在蛹上，我晃了晃。
lines.en: Arrow fletching brushes the chrysalis and I sway.

lines.zh: 壳里的变化忽然加快了。
lines.en: The change inside me suddenly accelerated.
I grow emptier inside my casing.
Lightning flashes through, and everything goes white.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉了，一直往下。
lines.en: I dropped from the branch and keep falling.
